# Vendored PICOBOOT library

`picoflash/*.js` and `picoflash/LICENSE` are unmodified from
https://github.com/piersfinlayson/picoflash/tree/9f647ee9c46a21f4d1efc2d272f19be6cd309d1d/pkg
(MIT, Piers Finlayson). Keep the license and commit pin when updating.

Only RP2040 is enabled by the DediBridge adapter. The upstream library also
supports other devices, which are outside this installer's scope.
